data.one_liner: Calculates file checksums as MD5 hashes using platform native implementations.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that computes an MD5 hash checksum for a given file path using native Android and iOS code. It executes hash calculation in a background thread to prevent blocking the main UI thread.
use_when: You need native MD5 file checksum calculation in a Flutter application
You want to process file hashing off the main thread
avoid_when: You want a pure Dart implementation, as the author notes native implementation is no longer necessary
You are starting a new project, because this project is archived and will no longer be updated
strengths: Calculates hashes in the background thread
weaknesses: The project is officially archived and will not receive updates
Pure Dart alternatives using crypto package are now considered comparable in performance

alternatives.name: crypto
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides pure Dart implementations of cryptographic hashes like MD5 without needing a native plugin, and the author suggests it as a modern alternative.
